title: Algolia Usage API key: documented role, undated migration, confidentiality not stated
summary: A key sent in the X-Algolia-API-Key header to the Usage API host, which replaces the deprecated usage endpoints of the Monitoring API.
rationale: Claims usage-api-key-exists, usage-api-key-acl-and-source and usage-api-key-plan-and-host record the role, the usage ACL, the header and the host; claim usage-api-key-monitoring-usage-endpoints-deprecated records a deprecation the page does not date, so no era is asserted (open-question-4). Whether the key is a distinct credential or an ACL profile (open-question-3) and whether Algolia expects the usage statistics and the key to be kept confidential (open-question-5) are not stated. The header is shared with every other role. Contract claims cited: usage-api-key/usage-api-key-acl-and-source, usage-api-key/usage-api-key-monitoring-usage-endpoints-deprecated.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: an Algolia statement of the confidentiality expected for a Usage key, or a dated changelog entry for the migration.

sources.supports: Use usage API (usage): allowed to retrieve data with the Usage API.
You can find the APPLICATION_ID variable in your dashboard, and the API_KEY variable on the API Keys page, under the Usage section.
The X-Algolia-Application-Id header identifies which app you are accessing, and the X-Algolia-API-Key header authenticates the endpoint.
The usage endpoints of the Monitoring API are now deprecated. You should migrate to the new Usage API.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
